themes_detail.label: Street Condition Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Street condition complaints spiked to 148 THIS WEEK, a 241% surge vs. the 43.4-complaint weekly average over the prior 8 weeks (z-score 7.81), signaling a sudden deterioration in road quality across CD 405 that demands immediate DOT investigation.
evidence: 148 street condition complaints THIS WEEK vs. 43.4 weekly average (8-week baseline)
241% spike with z-score of 7.81 (highest statistical severity in dataset)
Convergence with curb condition spike (357% up, 8 complaints this week vs. 1.8 avg) suggests localized infrastructure failure
reporting_angles: What triggered the sudden street deterioration — pothole epidemic, winter damage acceleration, or deferred maintenance?
Interview DOT about response timeline and which specific blocks/corridors are most affected

themes_detail.label: Curb & Obstruction Damage
themes_detail.summary: Curb condition complaints jumped 357% THIS WEEK (8 complaints vs. 1.8 weekly average, z-score 6.45), paralleling obstruction complaints that spiked 130% two weeks ago (17 vs. 7.4 avg), suggesting coordinated street infrastructure failure or construction-related damage.
evidence: 8 curb condition complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.8 weekly average (357% increase, z-score 6.45)
17 obstruction complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 7.4 average (130% increase, z-score 4.42)
Temporal clustering suggests shared root cause (construction, weather event, or maintenance contractor error)
reporting_angles: Is there active construction work in Ridgewood/Glendale causing collateral curb/obstruction damage?
Map complaint clusters to identify geographic hotspots and interview affected residents about parking, accessibility, and safety impacts

themes_detail.label: Food Safety Violations Spike
themes_detail.summary: Food establishment complaints surged 327% LAST WEEK (8 complaints vs. 1.9 weekly average, z-score 6.61), representing the second-highest statistical anomaly in the dataset and warranting urgent DOH inspection coordination.
evidence: 8 food establishment complaints LAST WEEK vs. 1.9 weekly average (327% spike, z-score 6.61)
Second-highest severity spike in full dataset after street conditions
No corresponding Reddit discussion or CB agenda item, suggesting underreported community concern
reporting_angles: Contact DOH to identify which establishments triggered complaints and what violations were cited
Investigate whether a single outbreak complaint or multiple locations are driving the spike

themes_detail.label: Rodent Infestation Surge
themes_detail.summary: Rodent complaints jumped 146% THIS WEEK (16 complaints vs. 6.5 weekly average, z-score 4.61), converging with elevated dirty condition reports (174% up LAST WEEK: 51 vs. 18.6 avg) to suggest deteriorating sanitation conditions district-wide.
evidence: 16 rodent complaints THIS WEEK vs. 6.5 weekly average (146% increase, z-score 4.61)
51 dirty condition complaints LAST WEEK vs. 18.6 average (174% spike, z-score 4.3)
Temporal convergence of rodent and sanitation complaints suggests common cause: trash accumulation, street cleaning lapses, or waste management contractor issues
reporting_angles: Which neighborhoods in CD 405 are hotspots — Ridgewood, Glendale, or Middle Village?
Interview residents and DSNY about street sweeping schedules and trash collection adequacy; consult DOHMH on rodent abatement response

themes_detail.label: Residential Noise & Building Complaints
themes_detail.summary: Residential noise complaints spiked 84% TWO WEEKS AGO (114 vs. 62.0 weekly average, z-score 3.98), paired with building/use violations up 90% THIS WEEK (19 vs. 10.0 avg, z-score 6.36), suggesting either new construction disturbance or unlicensed residential use conflicts.
evidence: 114 residential noise complaints 2 WEEKS AGO vs. 62.0 weekly average (84% spike, z-score 3.98)
19 building/use complaints THIS WEEK vs. 10.0 average (90% increase, z-score 6.36)
405 DOB permits filed in last 90 days (318 alterations) suggest active construction; CB budget repeatedly requests additional building inspectors (unfunded)
reporting_angles: Are noise spikes tied to specific construction sites — link to ULURP rezonings or permit clusters?
Interview CB about enforcer staffing gaps and why inspector requests have been repeatedly denied; profile a resident dealing with noise/building violations
